contexts.title: FORGE RIG guide

normal_workflow: Use the Rig to observe health and load
Open the relevant feature tab to change behavior

Stale data: refresh and inspect source age
A missing metric is not evidence of zero usage

contexts.title: Rune Forge guide
contexts.purpose: Add Development Policy sources and inspect Stjornarvald observations without stopping development.
forge_handles_automatically: Accept every selected file or folder format before interpretation
Apply the pinned Raven Forge Development baseline
Keep bounded source, violation, correction, repetition, reopening, and delivery history
Continue ordinary tools, runs, queues, and completion when policy processing is degraded
controls: Inspect source identity and interpretation state
Inspect policy violations and delivery state
status_meanings: Accepted means the source is active even before interpretation finishes
Cataloging and Partially indexed describe best-effort interpretation
Delivery pending means the durable violation has not reached a future agent boundary
Corrected, Repeated, and Reopened append history rather than replacing it
Development continuing means no tool, run, queue, or completion was restricted
normal_workflow: Choose Add Development Policy and select any one file or folder
Confirm that it appears immediately in Policy sources
Open a source to inspect its path, revision, and interpretation observation
Open a violation to inspect its exact rule, evidence, confidence, correction, and delivery state
Use Export Policy Log when a portable history is needed
troubleshooting: Manager unavailable: cached sources and violations remain visible; retry refresh later
Source unavailable: keep the source active and restore or refresh its selected path
Partially indexed: inspect the interpretation observation for unsupported or opaque content
Delivery pending: development continues and the notice waits for a safe future agent boundary
advanced_details: Policy binding revision and rule locator
Observation evidence, assumptions, alternatives, and confidence
Append-only violation sequence and delivery receipt state
